description: This file contains the implementation of logical and conditional functions for a PHP spreadsheet calculation library, including functions like IF, SWITCH, IFERROR, IFNA, and IFS.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: Provides static methods implementing Excel-like logical and conditional functions for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: statementIf
methods.description: Implements the Excel IF function, returning one value if a condition is TRUE, another if FALSE.

methods.name: statementSwitch
methods.description: Implements the SWITCH function, returning the first matching result based on the expression.

methods.name: IFERROR
methods.description: Implements the IFERROR function, returning a specified value if an error is detected.

methods.name: IFNA
methods.description: Implements the IFNA function, returning a specified value if the input is the #N/A error.

methods.name: IFS
methods.description: Implements the IFS function, evaluating multiple conditions and returning corresponding results.
